Developer- Credit Analytics
Location
US-MO-Saint Louis
ID
2026-10047
Category Banking & Lending Position Type Regular | Full Time Work Type Onsite
Why Stifel

Stifel strives for a culture that puts its clients and associates first: a culture where everyone belongs, everyone is welcome, and everyone contributes to the success of our clients, their careers, and the firm as a whole.

 

Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success.

What You'll Be Doing

The Developer – Credit Analytics supports the Bank’s Credit Analytics team by developing and maintaining data solutions that enable credit reporting, portfolio monitoring, and analytical decision-making. With guidance from the team, this position participates in all phases of the development lifecycle, including design, implementation, integration, testing, deployment, and maintenance. The Developer builds scalable data models, pipelines, automated processes, and reporting solutions while following Stifel’s development standards and best practices. This role partners with Credit Analytics and other stakeholders to understand business needs, improve access to reliable credit data, and deliver tools and insights that support the Bank’s credit risk management activities.

What We're Looking For
Assist the Development team in various phases of development, including design, implementation, integration, revision control, release and the maintenance of multiple products and systems
Build and maintain SQL views, stored procedures, ETL processes, and data pipelines (SQL Server / Snowflake
Assist in migration to Snowflake
Design scalable data models for reporting and analytics using dimensional modeling principles and develop executive dashboards in PowerBI.
Recognize manual systems and work to automate procedures.
Document clearly and effectively within code and participate in documentation outside of code
Ensuring Stifel's coding and development standards are being followed
Coordinate with other team members when tackling harder developmental efforts
What You'll Bring
Develop solutions to problems as well as manager multiple issues at the same time.
Strong awareness of the impact of actions on the product or feature and acts in line with it.
Ability to resolve problems, basic troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Collaboration with a team using knowledge of appropriate development environments
Strong oral and written communication skills
• Banking knowledge is a plus
Education & Experience
Minimum Required: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience
Minimum Required: 0-2 years' of post Bachelor's progressive experience in software development
Licenses & Credentials
Minimum Required: None
Systems & Technology
Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
Experience in SQL and Python and database systems
Experience with PowerBI (DAX) queries, Microsoft Power Tools
About Stifel

Stifel is more than 130 years old and still thinking like a start-up.  We are a global wealth management and investment banking firm serious about innovation and fresh ideas.  Built on a simple premise of safeguarding our clients’ money as if it were our own, coined by our namesake, Herman Stifel, our success is intimately tied to our commitment to helping families, companies, and municipalities find their own success.

 

While our headquarters is in St. Louis, we have offices in New York, San Francisco, Baltimore, London, Frankfurt, Toronto, and more than 400 other locations.  Stifel is home to approximately 9,000 individuals who are currently building their careers as financial advisors, research analysts, project managers, marketing specialists, developers, bankers, operations associates, among hundreds more.  Let’s talk about how you can find your place here at Stifel, where success meets success.

 

At Stifel we offer an entrepreneurial environment, comprehensive benefits package to include health, dental and vision care, 401k, wellness initiatives, life insurance, and paid time off.

 

Stifel’s bank and trust companies are equal opportunity employers.
